relevant_incidents.title: Emergency Migration - DUB109KVM
relevant_incidents.text: Dublin Datacenter Emergency Migration - DUB109KVM Due to recent hardware issues affecting DUB109KVM, we are performing an emergency migration of all affected VPS instances to another healthy node: DUB114KVM. We anticipate that troubleshooting and resolving the hardware issues with the original node will require additional time, so we are moving services to a healthy host node to maintain stability. All VPS data and configurations will be preserved, and no data loss is expected. Each VPS will experience a brief interruption while its migration is performed, generally lasting less than 15 minutes per VM. Customers will receive an email once their individual VPS migration is complete. We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience as we complete these migrations. We will update this incident once all affected services have been migrated. UPDATE: This has been successfully completed.

extraction.retained_scope: The original BAG coordinate remains evidence of the AMS9 address unit at Science Park 121. Its exact original canonical metadata and coordinates are preserved; it is not reinterpreted as an AMS17 point or as a previously established campus locator.
extraction.previous_precision: Official BAG verblijfsobject point (0363010003684984, in use, office use, 3,300 m2) of Science Park 121, 1098 XG Amsterdam, the address Digital Realty publishes for AMS9; it coincides with the BAG address point and lies inside the linked pand 0363100012104927 (in use, built 1960, 11 verblijfsobjecten, about 12,490 m2 footprint with one courtyard), 3.2 m inside the footprint boundary and 80 m from its centroid. The pand is a multi-unit research-park complex that also holds Science Park 105 and 123, so the point marks the AMS9 address unit, not a surveyed data-hall outline.
extraction.previous_uncertainty_reason: The BAG register publishes no positional accuracy for verblijfsobject points; the linked pand is a large multi-unit complex whose footprint extends up to about 210 m from the point, Digital Realty's own structured point lies 163 m away inside it, and no data-hall plan is published.
